visualCharacteristics: One image in a <figure>, centred in the content column at its natural size (never wider than the column)
Optional caption under the image: small slate text (body-font-size-s), links and emphasis kept
Optional link around the image, cyan focus ring
Wide fills the content column; narrow is a ~720px reading column; full bleeds edge to edge with the caption kept in the content column
Left / right float the image (~42%, max 520px) beside the text that follows it on desktop (>= 900px) and stack on mobile
Rounded uses the site card radius (15px); bordered adds a 1px light-grey hairline
contentPattern: Rows in any order; empty rows are ignored
Picture row (required): a single picture; without one the block renders nothing
Optional link row: a row holding only a link makes the image link there (a link wrapped around the picture also works)
Optional caption row: any other text (paragraphs, links, emphasis) becomes the figcaption
usage: Ad-hoc content updates in Document Authoring: drop a single image into any page, with an optional caption and link.
reuseGuidance: Use for one standalone image. For an image with heading and CTA use teaser; for a picture behind copy use hero; for several images use cards or columns; for Dynamic Media assets by URL use dynamic-media.
